# Contract: Generated nginx Configuration

The exact text `nginxDriver.render` produces, and therefore what
`sync-proxy` previews and writes. Example values only (constitution I).
Indentation is four spaces; blank lines are exactly as shown; the file ends
with `}` and no trailing newline (the delivery script's heredoc adds one).

## File skeleton (always present, even with no routes)

```nginx
# Generated by Bellhop sync-proxy. Do not edit: this file is replaced on every apply.

map $http_upgrade $bellhop_connection_upgrade {
    default upgrade;
    ''      '';
}

map $http_host $bellhop_http_host {
    default $http_host;
    ''      $host;
}
```

Each route then appends a blank line and one `server` block.

## Proxy lines (`<proxy lines>` below)

Shared by `location /` and every exempt location, for backend
`<scheme>://<ip>:<port>`:

```nginx
        proxy_pass <scheme>://192.0.2.10:8080;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $bellhop_http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $bellhop_http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Port 443;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection $bellhop_connection_upgrade;
```

followed, for an HTTPS backend, by exactly one of:

| Route | Scheme | Extra lines |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `insecureTls: true` (any port) | `https` | `proxy_ssl_verify off;` |
| port 443, `insecureTls: false` | `https` | `proxy_ssl_verify on;` then `proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt;` |
| otherwise | `http` | none |

`X-Forwarded-Port` is `ctx.externalPort`.

## Ungated or OIDC route

```nginx
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    listen [::]:443 ssl;
    server_name app.example.com alias.example.com;

    ssl_certificate "/etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/fullchain.pem";
    ssl_certificate_key "/etc/letsencrypt/live/example.com/privkey.pem";

    client_max_body_size 0;
    proxy_buffering off;
    proxy_request_buffering off;
    proxy_read_timeout 1d;
    proxy_send_timeout 1d;

    location / {
<proxy lines>
    }
}
```

`server_name` lists `route.hostnames` in order (canonical first). Certificate
paths come from `ctx.tls` and are double-quoted.

## Forward-gated route

Differences from the ungated block:

1. After `proxy_send_timeout 1d;`:
   ```nginx
       proxy_buffers 8 16k;
       proxy_buffer_size 32k;
   ```
2. `location /` appends, after its proxy lines (omitted entirely when an
   exempt `/*` is present):
   ```nginx
           auth_request /outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/nginx;
           error_page 401 = @goauthentik_proxy_signin;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_auth_cookie $upstream_http_set_cookie;
           add_header Set-Cookie $bellhop_auth_cookie;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_authentik_username $upstream_http_x_authentik_username;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_authentik_groups $upstream_http_x_authentik_groups;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_authentik_email $upstream_http_x_authentik_email;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_authentik_name $upstream_http_x_authentik_name;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_authentik_uid $upstream_http_x_authentik_uid;
           proxy_set_header X-authentik-username $bellhop_authentik_username;
           proxy_set_header X-authentik-groups $bellhop_authentik_groups;
           proxy_set_header X-authentik-email $bellhop_authentik_email;
           proxy_set_header X-authentik-name $bellhop_authentik_name;
           proxy_set_header X-authentik-uid $bellhop_authentik_uid;
   ```
3. After `location /`, one location per unique exempt pattern other than
   `/*`, in stored order, each containing only `<proxy lines>`:
   ```nginx
       location = "/health" {
   <proxy lines>
       }

       location ^~ "/api/" {
   <proxy lines>
       }
   ```
   A path's `\` and `"` are backslash-escaped inside the quotes. A pattern
   whose path is exactly `/outpost.goauthentik.io`, or anything under
   `/outpost.goauthentik.io/`, produces no location at all -- it is silently
   skipped (never thrown on), since such a location would outrank the
   outpost passthrough location below and misroute its `auth_request`
   subrequest to the site's own backend (research R7). A guest edit
   rejects such a path before it's saved; the skip covers one saved earlier.
4. Then the outpost passthrough and sign-in locations, with
   `ctx.outpost` = `192.0.2.20:9000`:
   ```nginx
       location /outpost.goauthentik.io {
           proxy_pass http://192.0.2.20:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io;
           proxy_set_header Host $bellhop_http_host;
           proxy_set_header X-Original-URL $scheme://$bellhop_http_host$request_uri;
           add_header Set-Cookie $bellhop_auth_cookie;
           auth_request_set $bellhop_auth_cookie $upstream_http_set_cookie;
           proxy_pass_request_body off;
           proxy_set_header Content-Length "";
       }

       location @goauthentik_proxy_signin {
           internal;
           add_header Set-Cookie $bellhop_auth_cookie;
           return 302 /outpost.goauthentik.io/start?rd=$scheme://$bellhop_http_host$request_uri;
       }
   ```

Locations inside a server are separated by one blank line.

## Delivery (unchanged `fileDriver` contract)

- Payload: `[{ path: configPath, mode: 'owned', content, ownedHeader }]`,
  where `ownedHeader` is the file's first line (the header comment above).
- Preview: `content`, exactly.
- Apply: first, if `configPath` exists and its first line is not exactly
  `ownedHeader`, print an error naming the path and how to fix it
  (repoint or unset `proxyConfigPath`, or remove the file) and exit
  non-zero before any backup, write, validate, or reload. Then back up `configPath` (or note absence), write it whole, `nginx -t`;
  on failure restore/remove and exit non-zero without reloading; on success
  `systemctl reload nginx`.
- Snapshot: `cat <configPath>`.
